caption: Only the two configurations in the frozen comparison plan are shown. Structures are weighted equally; paired 95% intervals resample related groups. R-precision is primary; the other metrics are secondary and intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted. Long-range metrics require sequence separation at least 24 and exclude targets without such contacts. GPU-stage times exclude model loading, staging, CPU aggregation and failed/preempted work. The reserved set was previously used for the proofreader release; generator pretraining decontamination is not established.
